### What It Takes to Struggle with Something Hard
Author: Rachel Olsen
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-november-30-2012.html
Passage: Romans 8:37
Points:
- Debilitating trials and chronic pain can tempt us to feel defeated and forgotten by God.
- Personal suffering is never evidence of God's indifference or lack of love toward us.
- Being more than a conqueror means depending on God's strength and persevering with hope while walking through hardship.
- Overwhelming victory belongs to believers in Christ, who promises deliverance either in this life or eternity.

### The Making of More Than a Conqueror
Author: Scott Hubbard
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-making-of-more-than-a-conqueror
Passage: Romans 8:35-39
Points:
- Anxiety forces believers to ask whether the love of Christ will still hold when our worst fears come true.
- True confidence does not deny the reality of deep affliction, persecution, or grief, but faces them directly in Christ.
- Jesus established His conquering love at the cross, showing that apparent defeat can become ultimate victory.
- Being more than conquerors means our trials are transformed into servants working for our eternal good.
- Because the risen Christ holds us and intercedes for us, nothing in all creation can sever us from His grasp.
